snippet.title: Scramble Heart City - Trailer
snippet.description:
Scramble Heart City is a browser-based 3v3 tag-team fighter. It's time to beat up your friends and find new ones! Play anywhere with local and online multiplayer and Steam/browser crossplay.

The playable roster includes 8 original characters that drip with style, all hand drawn and animated frame by frame. The game is beginner-friendly to pick up and play but also features deep team and movement mechanics that reward practice and mastery.

Playtests happening now! Join our Discord for details, and ✨ wishlist our game on Steam! ✨

🥊 Game Website: https://scrambleheart.city
📣 Discord: https://discord.gg/6hbrfUgZJB
🕹️ Steam Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3041800/Scramble_Heart_City/
